widgets_values: The image is a vertical photograph of a young woman in her twenties standing in the shadowed courtyard of a Jiangnan garden, a whitewashed wall and a grey tile eave behind her. In the upper band of the frame the roofline runs horizontally, moss darkening the tiles along its edge, and a lattice window with torn rice paper occupies the upper-left corner. The courtyard floor is laid in irregular grey flagstones, damp in patches, filling the lower third. She stands just right of centre, turned three-quarters toward the camera, one hand holding a folded paper fan closed against her hip, the other hanging at her side. Her head is inclined slightly and her gaze goes off frame to the left, past the viewer, with a composed and distant expression. Her hair is black and drawn back into a low bun at the nape, held by a single pale jade pin, a few loose strands at the temple. Her skin is fair and cool-toned, matte in the shade. She wears a deep teal silk qipao with a high mandarin collar, the fabric showing a faint sheen where the light grazes it, a row of small knotted closures running diagonally from the collar to the right armpit, and a slit at the hem that shows a layer of pale cream cotton beneath. The fan in her hand is folded, its ribs of thin bamboo and its paper a muted ochre carrying an ink wash that stays blurred rather than stating a landscape. Two thin jade bangles sit on her right wrist. Along the right edge three bamboo stalks lean into the frame out of focus, and a stone basin of still water sits low in the lower-left, a few fallen leaves floating on its surface. The lighting is low raking afternoon sun entering from the right, cutting across the flagstones in long diagonal bars, catching the edge of the silk and the jade pin while leaving the wall behind in flat cool shade; fine dust hangs visible in the light near the bamboo. The overall composition is near-symmetrical and vertically anchored, framed by the eave above and the stones below, with a muted palette of grey, chalk white and deep teal, and a still, restrained, faintly melancholic mood.
